name: Dynamic Asteroids: Extreme Edition 2.0 (Cyclone)
author: keltuze
description: Extreme Edition 2.0: Living asteroid belts with endless planetary ring avalanche, omnidirectional 360 cyclones & anticyclones, multi-angle converging swarms, and 5% targeted sniper torrents against ships! Features zero lag at 300+ asteroids (120 FPS), sparkling kinetic trails, and live hotkeys [/] to toggle and [Shift +/-] to adjust density in simulation.
